tools.name: Controlla Voice

tools.name: ACE Studio

Laden with over 80 multilingual, royalty-free AI voices spanning genres from pop to cinematic, opera to R&B, it brings vocal realism into your browser or desktop. tools.name: VoiceClone-AI
tools.description:

bullets: Rapid
intuitive cloning process.

tools.name: Parrot Talk
tools.description: Parrot Talk, often referred to as Parrot AI, is an AI-powered voice cloner, generator, and video creation tool. The platform enables users to create engaging content by converting text to speech, generating AI music from YouTube URLs, and creating short videos with lip-syncing and facial expressions. It's primarily designed for creating funny, entertaining, and creative audio and video clips.
bullets: Versatile Voice Options: Offers a wide range of popular celebrity AI voices and the ability to clone custom voices.

tools.name: NotebookAI Podcast
tools.description:
AIdeaFlow Podcast is an AI-powered platform that automates the process of transforming text—like articles, PDFs, or scripts—into polished, human-like podcast audio. It leverages advanced Triton TTS models (including Gemini, WorldSpeak, and others) to produce natural-sounding voiceovers in over 31 languages using more than 120 unique voices. You can input content via text, file upload, or URL, and let the AI handle pacing, tone, and voice selection. 
With support for single speakers, interactive dialogues, and voice cloning, it suits a wide range of creators—from educators turning lecture notes into spoken content to marketers producing audio campaigns. AIdeaFlow features intelligent editing tools to remove errors, manage silence, and add music or effects.
bullets: Natural and expressive AI voices that feel human.
Easy-to-use tool that requires no audio expertise.

tools.name: SeekhoAI

Designed with learners, professionals, and content consumers in mind, Seekho AI helps transform passive reading into active listening, making it easier to absorb knowledge on the go. The platform is currently available on iOS and iPadOS devices and supports more than 10 languages, including English, Hindi, Spanish, French, and German. Users can also choose from various podcast tones and lengths, tailoring each audio lesson to their learning preferences.
